voice.note: one file per block or one merged file; never change the words

blocks.screen_text: same text with digits and key words

visual_style.mood: calm night, premium, curious. Never scary. No saturated red anywhere.
visual_style.background: vertical navy gradient + 10-14 soft bokeh circles (violet/teal/rose, opacity 0.05-0.08, blur 22px) drifting slowly
visual_style.silhouettes: flat dark-filled body shapes with a soft neon glow outline, women rose, men cyan, soft aura behind breathing on a 2.5 s sine; figures stay in y 520-1180
visual_style.organs: glowing soft circles inside the body, pulse with the topic (heartbeat 1.1 s); zoom-in = scale 1 to 2.2 in 0.8 s ease in-out
visual_style.data_visuals: vertical amber rulers with ticks and a glowing marker, count-up numbers (ease out 1.2 s), side-by-side comparisons, one big number per shot (140+ px)

typography.title: 96 px, white with one amber keyword, y 300-450, only the first 3 s
typography.karaoke: 76 px, spoken words white, current word amber, upcoming words dim gray, 3 words per line, 2 lines, baseline y 1330, centered
typography.rule: never show a title and subtitles with the same words at the same time

visual_style.motion: draw-on and fade-in 0.25-0.4 s ease out, tiny overshoot, hard cut on a new idea, slow push-in 4-6 percent on the key word, a new visual event every 2-3 s
visual_style.sound: soft whoosh on cuts, glass ting on number reveals, low thump on heartbeat, riser before the key reveal, 0.3 s silence before a reveal, SFX 10-14 dB under voice, NO music

shot_patterns: question: title + two silhouettes + aura pulse
compare: two rulers rise to different heights, numbers count up
organ zoom: figure scales up, organ glows, label chip
timeline: bar with 3-5 dots, active dot amber (real values from the script only)
myth vs fact: myth fades gray, fact glows mint
closing: silhouettes dim, rose GLOW pill with a down arrow

implementation.kit: .claude/skills/neon-body-reel-studio/templates/neon_kit.js (frame, bokeh, body, organ, ruler, karaoke, prog, ease)
implementation.method: scene.html exposes window.update(t) as a pure function of t and draws one SVG per frame; Playwright screenshots each frame; ffmpeg assembles with voice and SFX
implementation.word_timing: faster-whisper word_timestamps -> words.json; fallback ffprobe durations + character spread
implementation.gpu: not required (SVG + CSS); on Windows use normal Chromium, SOFTWARE_GL only if a GPU error appears

workflow: fill beats from the voiceover words
one still per shot + contact sheet, show the owner and WAIT
animate, add karaoke subtitles and SFX
qa_checklist: topic and question visible in the first 2 s
no red as a main color, nothing scary
a visual event every 2-3 s, every claim has a visual proof
only one text system at a time (title OR karaoke)
text inside safe zones, figures not hidden by subtitles
numbers on screen match the script, honesty chips where needed (e.g. small study, 2024 US data)
no health-result promises, prices, free, hashtags, music
audio sync checked on 3 trigger words
do_not: do not invent facts or numbers
do not use red as the main color
do not render the full video before the owner approves the contact sheet
